newsitem.title: USA: CNF's Emery unit adds jets to handle volume.
newsitem.headline: CNF's Emery unit adds jets to handle volume.

text.p: Emory Worldwide said Monday it is temporarily adding four widebody L-1011 aircraft to its North American operations in anticipation of strong cargo volumes during the remainder of 1997 and into early 1998.

The four jets, which are being leased, will replace previously used DC-8s that had smaller cargo-lift capacities, the company said. The L-1011s each have 126,000 pounds of capacity versus an 80,000 pound limit on the DC-8s.
The jets will be providing regular scheduled service to Dallas, Los Angeles, San Jose, Calif., and Portland, Ore.

A company spokesman was not immediately available to provide further details. The company press release did not say whether the Teamsters strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc had contributed to the decision.
